chunks: He (peace be upon him) said to his secretary 'Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi':
Put cotton flake in the ink-pot, keep the nib of your pen long, leave space between lines and close up the letters because this is good for the beauty of the writing.
ai.seo_question: What are the key techniques for beautiful calligraphy according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs his secretary 'Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi' on the aesthetic principles of calligraphy, emphasizing that visual clarity enhances the reception of divine words. This guidance reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of valuing *adab* (etiquette) and beauty in the preservation of the Quran, linking physical presentation to spiritual reverence. The advice to space lines and condense letters underscores the importance of legibility and elegance in Islamic manuscript culture.
